--- title: "Team Project Overview" toc: true toc-location: right execute: echo: false warning: false message: false --- The team project is the capstone of the course — and the only piece of fully open-ended work. In teams of **3–4**, you'll propose and build an ambitious, real-world project of your own design, applying every workflow skill from the semester: version control, planning, skills, automation, debugging, continuous integration, deployment, and (where it helps) multi-agent orchestration. Throughout the final weeks, class sessions become **team work sessions** where the instructor circulates, audits progress, and gives direction — and where we learn collaboration workflows (pull request reviews, issues, and fork → branch → merge) live, as you need them. **Summary of deliverables:**
Item | Weight | Due -----|--------|----------------- [Proposal](1-proposal.qmd) | 5% | Feb 18 (Week 6) [Interim Report](2-interim-report.qmd) | 10% | Mar 25 (Week 11) [Final Report](3-final-report.qmd) | 25% | Apr 22 (Week 15) [Final Presentation](4-presentation.qmd) | 10% | Apr 29 (Week 16)
